qa.Rationale: Inference sharing objective explicit.
MPS allocation and adaptive batching described.
Confidence intervals shown; repeated-run count not specified for retained results.
V100 testbed, kernel, frameworks and concurrent models specified.
TensorRT comparison matches GPU-ready batch execution and states excluded transport costs.
GUE defined as an efficacy metric; table values are not busy percentages.
qa.Source anchor: PDF p3; printed p494; PDF p9 Table3

qa.Rationale: Median latency and SLO shown; request-tail quantile not established.
Two-to-four-function combinations evaluated.
Performance boundary evaluated under allocated GPU shares; no adversarial guarantee inferred.
Implementation and sensitivity described; full reproduction package not established in accessed copy.
Predictable multi-model inference objective and target behavior explicit.
Controller scheduling, worker actions and managed model runtime described.
Section6.6 reports three scaling repetitions; repeated-run count for retained Figure5 is not specified.
V100 hardware, TVM v0.7 compiler, model set and client configuration are reported.
INFaaS uses different EC2 machines; authors restrict that contrast to qualitative interpretation.
Goodput counts successful requests within their deadline and excludes late requests.
SLO range, closed-loop load, latency CDF and batch scheduling explanation are explicit.
Concurrent model demand and a protected minor workload tested.
Performance-isolation boundary is measured; dedicated-worker assumptions and security exclusions are explicit.
Runtime, scheduling, model details and limitations support informed implementation appraisal; no local reproduction claimed.
Inference-priority co-location objective and training progress goal explicit.
VMM pool, handover, memory mapping and SM allocation described.
Trace distributions and 300-second window specified; repeated-run uncertainty not specified for Figure10.
V100/A100 cases, CPU/RAM, software versions and model/batch table supplied.
TaskSwitch is an adapted implementation; equivalence to unmodified PipeSwitch is not established.
Training samples/second and inference SLO compliance are defined separately.
P99, arrivals, duration and four-times-solo SLO definition stated.
Inference plus Swin-T training co-location evaluated on a single GPU.
Handover correctness and priority boundary described; direct fault-injection validation not established.
Artifact appendix reports availability, functionality and reproduction badges with artifact DOI.
SLO-constrained inference resource objective explicit.
MIG/MPS profiling, segment configuration and allocation algorithms described.
Profiler and six scenarios specified; repeated-run uncertainty not established.
A100, Ubuntu and CUDA reported; printed PyTorch1.14.0 string is an unresolved environment ambiguity.
Local process-count contrast interpretable; fleet baseline variants and manuscript scope constrain comparison.
Local throughput values and metric units given.
qa.Source anchor: arXiv v1 PDF pp4-5; Figure3; sectionIII-B

qa.Rationale: Local latency values given without a named tail quantile.
qa.Source anchor: arXiv v1 PDF pp4-5; Figure4; sectionIII-B

qa.Rationale: One-to-three MPS processes measured inside a MIG segment.
MIG/MPS boundary described; no dedicated fault or adversarial experiment established in reviewed manuscript.
Algorithms and reconfiguration limitation described; accessed manuscript has no verified final-version equivalence.
qa.Source anchor: arXiv v1 PDF pp5-10; sectionIII-F; source/version record

qa.Rationale: Low-frequency serverless inference density and latency objectives explicit.
Remoting, swapping, memory manager, scheduler and two runtime modes described.
Trace, rates and warm-up specified; repeated-run uncertainty not specified for retained Figure8.
Worker and model configuration supplied; exact OS/driver/framework version matrix not specified in setup.
Native and adapted INFless-KA baselines described; CPU execution paths and adaptations affect equality.
Normalized single-GPU throughput and GPU busy-time definition supplied.
Default P98, per-function rates and deadlines stated.
Many low-frequency functions share one GPU; node-level results identified separately.
Runtime-sharing and runtime-isolation modes plus recovery design stated; dedicated fault-injection evaluation not established.
qa.Source anchor: PDF p7; section4.5; PDF p9 evaluation mode

qa.Rationale: Implementation and mode trade-offs explained; complete public replication recipe not established in paper.
Workflow runtime-redundancy and spatial-sharing objective explicit.
API proxy, PTB transformation, stream sharing and memory pool described.
Trace types, ablations and workloads stated; repeated-run uncertainty not specified for Figure13.
V100 hardware, CPU/RAM, framework versions, CUDA version and workflow descriptions reported.
qa.Source anchor: PDF p10; printed p67; setup; Table2

qa.Rationale: Warm-up and common optimizations disclosed; adapted baselines and batch/concurrency choices constrain causal attribution.
Throughput, memory metrics and comparator-specific factors explicitly reported.
Traffic SLO and CDF supplied; exact scalar request-tail quantile not supplied for retained throughput result.
Separate three- and six-user single-GPU tests supplied.
Mutual trust within workflow is explicit; separate proxies for users are distinguished from untested strong security.
Implementation, preparation costs and multi-user limitations sufficiently detailed for informed appraisal.
Compatibility, isolation and performance-control objectives explicit.
Kernel interception, token control and MIG orchestration explained.
Setup and workloads detailed; repeated-run uncertainty not specified for retained QoS result.
OS, kernel, driver, runtimes, GPUs and workloads explicitly tabulated.
Isolation-capable baselines and MIG adaptations described; policy and allocation differences limit equivalence.
Throughput targets are solo-normalized and QoS violation is a request fraction.
Solo-P99 threshold, Poisson load, subsequent rate halving and token sizes stated.
Co-running inference relative-error and QoS experiments supplied.
Baseline fault propagation is tested; design/security argument does not directly establish universal KRYPTON containment.
qa.Source anchor: PDF p4 Figure3; PDF p14 section7

qa.Rationale: Implementation and MIG limitation detailed; complete end-to-end replication package not established.
